mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ATTENDENCE VALUES( SEQ_ATTENDENCE.NEXTVAL, TO_DATE('${dateTime}', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), NULL, #{empCode}, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(ATTENDANCE_TIME, 'HH24:MI:SS') "arrivalTime" FROM ATTENDENCE WHERE EMP_CODE = #{empCode} AND TO_CHAR(ATTENDANCE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '${date}'
mapper.insert: UPDATE ATTENDENCE SET OFF_TIME = TO_DATE('${dateTime}', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE EMP_CODE = #{empCode} AND TO_CHAR(ATTENDANCE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '${date}'
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(OFF_TIME, 'HH24:MI:SS') "departureTime" FROM ATTENDENCE WHERE EMP_CODE = #{empCode} AND TO_CHAR(ATTENDANCE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '${date}'
